notablePrerequisites:
Livio does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Livio's first ability twice by paying {2}{W}{W}, exiling Dockside Extortionist and Village Bell-Ringer with aegis counters on them.
Activate Livio's second ability by paying {2}{W} and tapping it, returning Dockside Extortionist and Village Bell-Ringer from exile to the battlefield.
Village Bell-Ringer and Dockside Extortionist enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Village Bell-Ringer trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat from step 3.
